title: BAYERN REPORTEDLY OFFERED €70M AND STILL HAVE NO LEFT WINGER
description:
Seventy million euros later, the left wing is still empty.

Here's how it reportedly went. Bayern offered seventy million euros for Liverpool's eighteen-year-old winger Rio Ngumoha. Then they signed Ismael Saibari instead. Plan B arrived. The left wing is still waiting.

Bayern still want Ngumoha, but a later report says Liverpool have no plans to sell. They may try again in January or next summer. An offer, a signing and no left winger. That's less a transfer window, more a waiting room.
